pages.text: A whole haunch of T-Rex, roasted and set out on the tray. Place it on any solid surface and carve — a feast holds four servings, and use-clicking takes one at a time.

pages.title: Table Manners
pages.text: Feasts work like every Farmer's Delight centerpiece: the block remembers how much is left, and once the last serving is carved the empty tray breaks away.$(p)If a serving comes in a bowl or on bread, bring the container to the table — the roast will not lend you its dishes.
